summary.headline: Heaven as God’s Throne
summary.text: Theological defense of mathematical astrology alongside medicine, distinguishing divine power and miracles from heavenly nature. Heaven is described as God’s throne, whose astral bodies and natural activities reveal divine providence, wisdom, creative understanding, and hidden grace.
